title: Photography
slide_intent: Choose a photograph for what it lets someone understand about an athlete or event. The accompanying caption gives an individual and an occasion to an otherwise ambiguous scene.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can show personal relationships, effort and achievement by giving different kinds of moments room in the picture selection.
demonstration: Four photographs distinguish action, a personal close-up, context and expression. A note asks editors to name athletes and supply story context in captions.
practical_value: Choose the type of image the story needs, then identify the people and circumstances in its caption where possible.

content_islands.name: Editorial guidance
content_islands.spec: Set a bold introduction at left, followed by a paragraph on headlines and captions. Separate the naming tip beneath it.

content_islands.name: Four photographic roles
content_islands.spec: Create a two-by-two photo grid at right. Put a small red caption at the lower left of each image. Pair the throwing action and two-person close-up above the wider event scene and expressive portrait.
